steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: And you left, just like that?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: There's no point bickering with her, and I'm half sure she was only there to hold me up anyway. If the girl's not in the hospital anymore, then we first need to confirm her whereabouts.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: How's your end?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I took a shortcut. I'll be at the Basilica in a minute.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: If the situation allows, send an order to cooperate from the Lateran Curia to the Notarial Hall.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: I questioned the hospital staff. It was a trainee executor who admitted the girl, said he picked up a lost child and couldn't find her parents.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Procedure dictates he bring her back to the Notarial Hall.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Even if he's not there yet, I can find his location through the Hall's system.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I've gotta say, you being so capable isn't good news for me.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Oh, yeah, and after you report, stay there in the Basilica for now.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Oh? You don't need my help?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: No. I feel like something's waiting to happen.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Didn't something already happen?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: You know who I'm talking about.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Anyway, hang back there. You might be more useful to me that way.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Are you worried about me?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: I just don't want you scampering all over the place. Let me... conserve my energy.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: No problem, Shimmering Vigil.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Use my real name!

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Phew...

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: There's so many people here...

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Which makes it harder to find us.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: This is Pagus Ambrosius. Have you been here before, Cecelia?

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Mamma used to say she'd go to Ambrosius to buy things. Maybe she's here?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Tell me more about your mamma being taken. What exactly happened?

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Mamma got ill... this morning, I was talking to Mamma. Then someone came... from the Notarial Hall, with white clothes on.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Then after he left, people with gowns came in, and took Mamma away.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: (The Notarial Hall... Could this really be a kidnapping case...? Something doesn't feel right.)

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Where were you then, Cecelia? Did they see you? Where did your papà go?

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Is this going to help me find Mamma?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Er, not for certain... it's just, if you can tell me more, I might be able to find some leads.

steps.name: Sickly Mother
steps.text: Cecelia, my darling Cecelia... you have to hide. Don't let them find you...

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: In that case, please tell me her parents' family name, her home address, identity number, and your blood or legal relationship to her.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: If you have proper grounds to leave with Cecelia, you can tell me, and I'll take it into account in my decision.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Eze...

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Hold on, Cecelia.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Hello. It's me.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Yes, I'm in Pagus Ambrosius right now.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Right, I'm helping this child find her mother.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Return to the Hall? Alright, I was about to... I'll be roughly half an hour?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Right, copy that.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: M... Mister Ezell, are you going to take me to the Notarial Hall?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: That's right. Is something...

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: I'll give you a word of advice! If you truly care about Cecelia, then don't give her up to the Notarial Hall or the Lateran Curia! Or else, you'll regret it!

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Cecelia... I'm guessing you don't want to go to the Hall?

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Mamma said... I can't go there...

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: But! If they can tell me where Mamma is, then I will... I can go!

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Mamma's got an illness... I'm really worried...

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Cecelia... let me ask you one more thing. Had you seen that Liberi from just now?

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: No. I don't like her...

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Just give me a moment to think and I'll be with you, okay?
Cecelia's mother forbade her from going to the Notarial Hall, or from approaching executors.
An executor showed up before Cecelia's mother went missing.
Cecelia's mother went missing.
Cecelia was almost abducted by a suspicious Liberi, whose name is likely 'Patia.'
Patia said Cecelia cannot be given over to the Notarial Hall or the Lateran Curia.
And finally, something's... wrong with Cecelia's halo.
Would it even be possible for me to extricate myself from this, at this point?
No...
Don't run away, Ezell...
Think...
What should you do?

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Mister... Ezell, in the hospital, you said, you would help me find Mamma. Is that true?

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Is that... still true, now?
This can't be the only solution.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: It's true, Cecelia. I promised you.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: We're not going to the Notarial Hall.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Do you still remember where your home is? I need to find someone else who knows your mother.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: I'll help you find her. That's my promise.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Thank you, Mister Ezell!

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: I don't know how to get back home from here. I've never been here before.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: But, if we go back to where I saw you, Mister... I know where my house is from there.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Not a problem. We'll take a different route back to Stevonus.

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: Welcome back, Mostima.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Time sure does fly, Your Holiness.

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: What news do you bring this time?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Relax, it won't be as bad as that one time.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Here's the physical report I mentioned before... Last page is a brief from Stevonus Central's head doc.

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: ...Considerably cautious wording.

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: Mostima, what is your view?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Going by the doctor who did the diagnosis and checkup, this report belongs to... an eight-year-old Sankta girl.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: All the details point to her being a Sankta, anyway.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Empath index isn't too high, but considering her age and physical condition, it's within acceptable range.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Question is these few figures here... My own checkups report similar results.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: But she's not even twelve yet. Never held a patron firearm. It's hard to imagine she's got the ability to violate any commandments. Outward appearances shoot down any chance she's fallen, either.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Doesn't leave very many possibilities. I think you'd have a better idea than me.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: If she's not fallen, another possibility is...

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: No. It's just as at odds with her appearance. Progeny like that aren't able to obtain halos.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Right, normally they can't. But we don't have many cases to go by, anyway.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Where is this child currently located? Where's Fiammetta?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Kid's out of Stevonus Central Hospital. Fiammetta's tracing her.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Apparently, it was one of the Hall's trainee executors who checked her in. Velliv, Fiammetta wants you to order the Notarial Hall to cooperate. She's on her way there right now.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: The Notarial Hall...

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Silver linings, am I right?

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: She just wants an order to cooperate? Is Fiammetta alone going to be enough?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: You forget that big conference in the Basilica? Thought you were more cautious than that, Velliv.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: How much does this trainee executor know about the child?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: No way to be sure. Hospital describes him as just a conscientious guy who 'saw a lost child and did the right thing,' at least when he admitted her.

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: Let Fiammetta handle it for now.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Yes, Your Holiness.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Aren't you going to participate, Mostima?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Not at the moment.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: While we were in Stevonus Central, Fiammetta met this Liberi who used to be Pontifica Cohors too.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: She likely made contact with the child, but according to the info Fiammetta sent back, it's not gone smoothly for her, whatever it was she wanted to do.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: But either way, she definitely used some apostate language.

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: Hm... you stay in the Basilica, then.

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: Vel, no need to jump the gun.

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: Any issues with the envoys arriving?

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Two detachments remain. Forecasts say they will arrive on time.

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: Very good then.

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: We'll wait a bit.

steps.name: Panicked Underling of Patia
steps.text: Patia, we're sorry, we lost them.

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: Forget it. He came to Pagus Ambrosius on purpose. The crowds are massive here, and all the alleys... For what looks like a novice, this executor's got a surprisingly decent hand on the ropes.

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: Ugh, this is a massive wrench in the plan. How could she fall straight into an executor's hands...

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: Who could it be now... Oren?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Things are getting tricky, Patia.

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: What, are you calling to mock me for it?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Not at all. Jokes are reserved for when things go without a hitch.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: I've got good news and bad news. Which do you wanna hear first?

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: And you said you wouldn't joke... The bad news.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Bad news is, the Lateran Curia caught wind already, and they're officially sending someone to intervene. Guess who got tasked?

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: ...Fiammetta.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Bingo!

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: I'm eager to hear what the good news could be.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Good news is, it's just Fiammetta. Mostima's been kept at the Basilica.

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: That counts as good enough. But the news I want to hear is what you are doing right now.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Real sharp of you. Because Mostima's been left behind, me and her have switched report times. Which means I'm free right now. How's that? Jumping for joy?

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: Not—a—chance—in—hell.

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: Also, Oren, I'm warning you, stop acting like you've got such a wealth of experience. I joined up with the Guide long before you did.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Alright, got it. I know I could never compete with your Miss Veter... hey, don't hang up, hold on, listen, I need you to hold Fiammetta off.

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: What about you?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: I'll be fetching Cecelia.

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: Why don't you hold Fiammetta off and I fetch Cecelia?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Ease up on the temper, okay? You know exactly why.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Besides, if you intercept Fiammetta, then no one's harmed even if you fail. And if I go handle that executor, the chances I succeed are better than yours.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Do you hate the Sankta, Patia?

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: What are you asking?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Answer the question.

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: I don't hate Sankta. What I hate is Liberi who put them up on an altar with absolutely no self-awareness.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: If you don't care about Sankta, then you'll never know what makes them tick.

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: What, are you trying to say you can get that executor to hand Cecelia to you because you're a Sankta, just like that?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: You've got it all wrong. Halos allow Sankta to sense each other, and better understand each other, but that's not to say we all get to live in a happy hive mind.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Emotional links, ones that are a little too strong, can be a weakness at certain times.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Sankta are just too accustomed to them. But once something abnormal happens to you, you get stuck with these... tiny little doubts that crop up.

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: Is that why you're on our side?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: On your side?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Nah, Patia. I'm not 'on your side.'

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: We're just going the same way by pure coincidence.
Oren, who were you on comms with?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: You really love rooftops, Mostima.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Same to you. All the Legati love a rooftop run, don't they, Oren?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Ooh... I saw you this morning. Props to you for that one.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: That was you, huh? I thought I was staring at someone's rooftop planters.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Huh? C'mon, don't I look good? It's the latest fashion in Victoria.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: All I know is fashion doesn't mean dyeing your hair so it clashes with all of you.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: You're such a Victoriaphile, Oren.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: It comes with the job. The glorious Legati demand a certain bearing.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Wanna guess at my job, then? Aren't you curious why I went to see the old weirdo out of nowhere?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: It's so secret, it might just sink Laterano...

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Stop!

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: I don't wanna know.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: You don't?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I was really hoping I'd get another helping hand.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Instead of meeting up with Fiammetta, you're going to recruit him?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Don't be like that, Velliv, I'm devoted to you, heart and soul.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Not one more disgusting joke out of you, Oren Argiolas.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: C'mon, even I have feelings.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Wow, that's the first I've heard of them.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: If you two have the time to chat, you'd better spend it rewriting your reports.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Hm? Is something wrong with my report?

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Guess how many seconds it took me to read it?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Uh... can't you combine my word count with Fiammetta's? We've written ten k or so, if you add us together.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: I'll have you know I spent five hours scribbling away like a monk.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Mostima's returned to Laterano more times than you had true facts in there, and I wouldn't mind reducing your allowance to match it.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I'm real worried, Oren.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Penny for your thoughts, Mostima.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: What if Lemuen ends up like Velliv eventually?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: You know how to paint a scary picture. I'm getting shivers.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Seems you two have all the time in the world.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Oren's a busy bee, don't you know.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: *Sigh* That's right, I'm busy-busy. In fact, it's about time I got going.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Until next time, my dear Velliv. I'll bring you some choux fingers.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: What are you looking at me for? I wasn't laughing.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Oren Argiolas... pray you do not fall into my hands.

steps.name: Notarial Hall Official
steps.text: Seniora Fiammetta, Ezell's already on his way back to the Hall. If we could just ask you to wait a little longer.

steps.name: Notarial Hall Official
steps.text: I'll bring you some tea.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: I'm fine.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Do you personally know Ezell?

steps.name: Notarial Hall Official
steps.text: I do. He's a trainee under me. Oh, right, you can call me Richele.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: How's his work? Anything dubious, ordinarily?

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Dubious? Uh, does refusing to work overtime count? He's always gone like a ghost the moment we clock out.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: But he's fairly good at his work. His practical training period's almost over, too, and he should be picking up a good score.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: I don't really mind him skipping overtime, though... he's a kid. Let him have his easy days. Once he gets onto field work, there's no line between on or off duty.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Bring up his position.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Are you really so suspicious of Ezell? I'd trust him well enough at this...

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Huh? Oh no... He really isn't moving for the Notarial Hall at all, huh?! What's he doing...?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Let me see!

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: With this orientation... he's heading back to Stevonus.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Seniora Fiammetta! Wait! If he really was up to something, he wouldn't leave his locator on. Just give this some thought, please.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: There's also the possibility this marker's a decoy.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: If he was faking the marker, then his decoy would be walking on back to the Notarial Hall like it should.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Seniora Fiammetta, please, put your trust in the Notarial Hall's executors.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: I'm not saying I don't trust him. I work here too.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Call it clearing him of suspicion.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Oh? We've lost his signal. You only just now remembered, Ezell? Still so young...

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: But if it was off to begin with, I wouldn't have defended him. Fine luck, you little brat...

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: I don't know what your plans are... but it's his deed, his to bear.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Getting some education from you can't do him bad, Seniora Fiammetta.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Ah. Welcome back, Federico.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Real frantic day in Stevonus today... wouldn't you say?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Was there a complication with the body?

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: I guess the whole show breezed right by you... The body's fine, the Ecclesia Requietum has it now.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Oh.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Don't you wanna ask what 'show?'

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: What 'show.'

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Never mind. Forget I said anything.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: But now that Feoria lady's dead, your trail's run dry, hasn't it?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: There are other options.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Like what?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Richele Colombo, I require that you access Feoria La Porta's travel logs.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: I'm never gonna get used to the way you speak.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: I can give them a lookup, but I just want you to know, I'm not writing your report.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: I will submit an application and report in accordance with followup investigation procedure.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Sure, okay.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Let's see...

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Hmmm?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Did you find something?

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: That's a curiosity. Come look at this.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: How long do you plan on following me?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Drop the act. I've had more and more eyes on me since the moment I stepped out of the Hall.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: You people should learn how to spy a little more subtly.

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: What can you do? They're not from service backgrounds, and they haven't been trained for long. They're doing great for where they're at.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Done pretending, Patia?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: As long as you don't get in my way, I don't intend on bothering you.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Look, we have our past. Let me give you a word of advice.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: No matter who you've seen, who's directing you, what you plan to do—it's still not too late to pull back.

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: Who's directing me?

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: And who's directing you, Fiammetta?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Don't make an enemy of the Lateran Curia, Patia.

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: And if I said my goal was to be an enemy of the Lateran Curia?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: ...I can still act as though I never heard that.

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: You're the same as before, aren't you?

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: You'll protect anything and everything... just for a tiny bit of friendship.

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: Shame I'm not who I used to be.

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: You can act like you didn't hear. But I can't act like I didn't say it.
